verdict: PARTIAL. The whole journey from a new idea to an approved, playable draft film works through the actual interface on the frozen code (final clean run 135/135, disposable-copy listening tests 5/5, planted reviewer defects 14/14, independent auditor reproduced the critical journeys). Paid narration is locked and was never called; budget, single-use authorization and take reuse are proven only with a mock (NOT TESTED). It is not ready to approve as finished: the automatic claim check misses the plainest form of the forbidden claim (FAIL), the "no effect" check for pronunciation fixes is only partly reliable, archival and product photographs are BLOCKED, there is no sign-in, and the draft film has visible draft-quality issues. Nothing should go to production or paid generation until the owner has reviewed the app and the film.

features.why: Operator input written by Claude (10 claims: 8 verified, 1 attributed, 1 marked avoid: "Rolex made the first waterproof watch"). The Studio stores, shows and enforces it; it cannot research by itself.

features.why: Versions, checks, diffs and decisions are the Studio's (v1–v7 in the final run); the text itself was written by Claude as operator input.

features.feature: Automatic check that stops an unsupported "first waterproof watch" claim
features.why: It stopped the planted claim in v1 and catches 12 of the 13 round-2 paraphrases, but the independent auditor's round 3 found it misses 6 of 10 new paraphrases, including the plainest form «اخترعت رولكس الساعة المقاومة للماء» (reproduced), and wrongly flags «في أول مرة نزلت فيها الساعة إلى الماء…». Several earlier fixes live in this project's research rule, so another project only gets what its own rule says. A word-rule check is not a reliable guard on its own; a person must read the script.

features.feature: The approved script and film make no unsupported claim
features.why: Checked by reading (Claude) and by the independent auditor: dates and facts on screen match the research; the "first waterproof watch" belief is attributed («يقولون…») in narration and on the hook card. Minor: the on-screen «تعمل بدقة» states as fact what the narration attributes.

separation: Tested for real through the interface (iPhone 13 size, plus desktop checks), on the frozen code: every owner action in stages A–J and the recovery cases.
Real, machine-only: word timings and transcripts (faster-whisper), the flagged-word audio comparison, A/V sync by cross-correlation, layout checks, the claim check. They inform; the owner decides.
Done by Claude outside the app and recorded as operator input: research, script text, hooks, the art brief, and answers to free-text art notes.
Mocked: the paid provider (ElevenLabs), in unit tests only. No real paid call was made; the gateway is disabled in this workspace and the Studio cannot import it.

Missing or blocked: licensed photographs (archival, Rolex product); a grammar/dialect checker; a spell checker for ordinary words; sign-in (the server trusts the actor the page sends); Studio projects inside the review dashboard and its phone (Artifact) copy; a human listening to the draft corrections.
automated: Final clean UI acceptance run on the frozen code (product commit 95a8646, harness 32f4187), started from an empty project, 12:41–13:35 UTC: 135 of 135 checks passed; seek/listening checks on a disposable copy 5 of 5; planted-defect copy 14 of 14 found. No code was changed during the run (product files hash-checked before and after).

Earlier full runs, kept as evidence: run 1 and 2 (before the first audit), run 3 (stopped after it found 4 problems), run 4 (129 passed, 2 failed: one harness assertion, one real defect), final attempt 1 (stopped at G by a harness timing mistake; A–F2 80 of 80).
Unit tests: 159 passed (1 expected failure documenting the Royal Oak article drops), network blocked, no credentials.
Review dashboard regression on the same code: UI flow 74 of 74, decision sync end-to-end 33 of 33.

Integrity after the final run: approved snapshot 194/194 files unchanged; Royal Oak approved set 30/30 unchanged; vendored engine provenance OK; all ledgers 0 spend and 0 paid approvals; no paid key in the environment; the production repository has no changes.
disagreements: Round 1 (19 defects D-01..D-19, 2 critical): the auditor showed my earlier PASS claims were not supported for the claim check, stale takes after a script change, identical "corrected" audio, bypassable listening, banner carry-over, and phone layout. All 19 were fixed and re-verified: 13 fixed in round 2, the rest fixed or narrowed in round 3.

Round 2 (on 98918fe): found N-1 (the opening visual ignored the selected hook, major) and partly-fixed D-02/D-03/D-04/D-05/D-18, plus N-2..N-6. All addressed in 95a8646; the auditor confirmed 9 of 10 fixed in round 3.

Round 3 (on frozen 95a8646): the claim check is still partly fixed, with a major miss of the plain claim; I agree and now classify it FAIL (it was PARTIAL). The "no effect" row should be PARTIAL, not PASS; I agree and changed it. The film shows a blank frame 0 and a black, silent end; I changed that row to PARTIAL.

Round 3: my first freeze file also hashed the harness and this classification, which changed after the freeze (harness commit 32f4187, disclosed; classification written after the run). The product-only hash (var/uat/FROZEN_PRODUCT_95a8646.sha256, 118 files) still matches.

Agreed with the auditor: J budget/single-use/reuse is NOT TESTED (mock only); a self-planted 14/14 is not proof of general reviewer quality (H row is PARTIAL); stopping the server is PASS with a ~20 s tail.
limitations: Licensed photographs are not in the project: archival (Gleitze 1927, Borgel, Tavannes, Daily Mail page) and Rolex product concepts are BLOCKED and cannot be selected. The film uses drawn and typographic scenes and a clearly labelled placeholder for Hans Wilsdorf (l6).
Research, script and hooks were written by Claude acting as the writer and posted as operator input; the Studio stores, checks and enforces them but does not write them.

The claim check is a word-rule check: 12 of the auditor's 13 false-claim variants are caught, with no false positives in the tested set. An implicit claim such as «قبل أويستر، لم تكن هناك ساعة يد تصمد في الماء» is not caught. The owner can approve over a critical finding with a written reason; the gate lists it.
Spelling: names, research terms and long words from approved versions only; a fresh typo of an ordinary word is not caught. No grammar or dialect checker.
The draft voice is gTTS (free, needs internet). Harness approvals are not pronunciation verdicts: the machine transcript heard the corrected «غلايتسه» as «بلايتسا». The owner must listen.
ElevenLabs: NOT TESTED by design. The final plan, budget, single-use authorization and take reuse are proven only with a mock provider in unit tests.

No sign-in: the local server trusts the actor the page sends (an owner decision could be spoofed by anyone who can reach the server). The server listens on 127.0.0.1 only. Needs real authentication before any shared deployment.
Studio projects are not in the review dashboard's project switcher or its phone (Artifact) copy; the review dashboard only links to the Studio.
A render that is interrupted restarts from 0 % when resumed.
Draft length is about 157 s with the slower draft voice; about 134 s estimated at the brand narrator's measured pace (1.74 words/s).
The dashboard runs only inside this development container (local server). There is no public link: publishing or deploying was not allowed in this test.
product_defects_fixed: See section 6 (defects.log entries without the [harness] tag): defects found by my own runs and by the three audit rounds, each fixed in the development workspace and re-tested; the critical ones are D-01 (stale audio after a script change) and D-02 (claim check), plus N-1 (the opening ignored the selected hook).

Run 3: the iPhone sideways-scroll check compared with innerWidth, which a phone widens with the overflow → compares with the screen width, reloads each screen.
Run 3/4: G expected script v5 / map v2 after the new hook-switch test → reads them from the state.
Run 4: J expected only the workspace lock while a legitimately open correction task still blocked → assertion corrected and re-run in a full run.
Round 2 (auditor): art checks passed even when a revision changed nothing; the inbox check missed pending revisions and stale plans; the listening check only tried a seek → all strengthened.
Final attempt 1: a fixed 1.2 s wait after Build → waits until the page is no longer busy; the whole final run was re-done from an empty project.
